text: Can you show me how my kitchen in this pic could look renovated, using the attached kitchen-before.jpg as the starting point? I've been thinking about a renovation for a while, and seeing it pictured would help me imagine the change. I'd like white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, and no clutter, and somewhere in all that I should mention that I want one 16:9 before-and-after image with the original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. Please keep the same room layout and camera angle, so it still feels like I'm looking at my own kitchen. Label the two sides exactly “Before” and “After”.
